description: This script automates the retrieval and deletion of Vercel deployments filtered by a specific meta tag. It fetches deployments via the Vercel API, filters them based on a meta tag, and deletes the matching deployments.
calls: echo -E $deployments | jq --arg META_TAG "$META_TAG" '[.deployments[] | select(.meta.base_hash | type == "string" and contains($META_TAG)) | .uid] | join(",")'
